title: Beyond Accuracy: An Explainability-Driven Analysis of Harmful Content Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Applying post-hoc explainability methods (SHAP and Integrated Gradients) to generate token-level attributions on individual predictions, revealing the model's over-reliance on explicit lexical cues (e.g., negative words, swear words) and its tendency toward lexical over-attribution in contextually benign situations.
Qualitative categorization and case-study analysis of false positives to identify the model's tendency to incorrectly flag non-toxic, politically affiliated comments or political jargon as harmful.
